action_resolutions.summary: Italy launched a full-scale two-pronged invasion of Ethiopia from Eritrea and Italian Somaliland, advancing through fierce mountainous and desert terrain toward Addis Ababa.

operation.reason: Italian forces advanced systematically from both colonies, overcoming Ethiopian defenses.

reports.title: The Battles of the Tembien and Amba Aradam
reports.report: The Italian Northern Army, supported by the Regia Aeronautica, broke through Ethiopian defensive lines in Tigray. The Blackshirt division spearheaded flanking maneuvers, securing key mountain passes.

reports.title: The Advance through the Ogaden
reports.report: In the south, General Graziani's forces pushed across the harsh Ogaden desert against tribal resistance, gradually grinding down Ethiopian outposts and securing waterholes.

reports.title: The Fall of Addis Ababa and Italian Annexation of Ethiopia
reports.report: Following the collapse of the northern and southern armies, Italian forces entered Addis Ababa. Emperor Haile Selassie was forced into exile, and the Italian government declared the annexation of the Ethiopian Empire.

events.title: The Fall of Addis Ababa
events.description: Italian troops occupy Addis Ababa, concluding organized resistance in the Second Italo-Ethiopian War. Emperor Haile Selassie flees into exile.

events.title: Accession of Edward VIII
events.description: Following the death of King George V, Edward VIII ascends the British throne.

events.title: The Remilitarization of the Rhineland
events.description: German military forces march into the demilitarized Rhineland, violating the Treaty of Versailles.
